n: a positive integer equal to the number of rows and columns of the Vandermonde matrix
x_i: the i-th real number in the list x_1,...,x_n
i: an integer row index or product index
k: an integer column index used in the descending sequence of column operations
A: the n-by-n Vandermonde matrix displayed in the theorem statement
C_k: the current k-th column of the matrix during the column-operation sequence
